property_summary: For any boolean _payRoyalties passed to initialize, the contract's public payRoyalties getter equals the passed _payRoyalties (the reference preserves the argument), whereas the mutant flips it so there exist inputs where payRoyalties() != _payRoyalties.
change_summary: On initialization, set payRoyalties to the negation of the provided _payRoyalties (flip the boolean) instead of assigning it directly.
